page_title: FRO 0-5 INT | Frosinone v Inter 10/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' Yann Bisseck (Inter) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
88' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
84' 0 - 5 What a goal that is! Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Michele Cerofolini and into the net. 0:5.
82' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) replaces Walid Cheddira.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Caleb Okoli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone).
80' 0 - 4 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:4.

77' 0 - 3 Goal! Tajon Buchanan (Inter) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Michele Cerofolini had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:3.
76' What a save from Yann Sommer! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
75' Substitution. Stefano Sensi (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Barella walks off.
75' A shot from the edge of the box by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
72' Substitution. Federico Dimarco walks off the pitch and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
71' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Pol Lirola and he is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone).
71' Substitution. Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) in, Reinier out.
71' Matias Soule (Frosinone) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
70' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) and Michele Cerofolini perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
68' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

67' The corner is slung over and Marcus Thuram (Inter) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
66' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
64' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Marko Arnautovic will be replaced by Lautaro Martinez (Inter).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Davy Klaassen (Inter) is replacing Davide Frattesi.

63' Matias Soule (Frosinone) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Yann Sommer!
60' 0 - 2 Goal Marko Arnautovic (Inter)! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) was put through by Davide Frattesi and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
59' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Yann Bisseck (Inter) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
59' The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
52' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
50' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes it short.

50' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Reinier (Frosinone) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
48' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Simone Inzaghi gives a chance to Juan Cuadrado and Matteo Darmian (Inter) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Antonio Giua starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A cross from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Frosinone are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
43' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
41' It should have been a goal! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
38' Luca Mazzitelli is being substituted because of an injury. Eusebio Di Francesco sends Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) on the pitch.
37' The game is interrupted now, Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:1.
31' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Reinier (Frosinone) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

25' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Yann Sommer thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
21' Referee Antonio Giua signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Inter players have a reason to celebrate!
20' Celebrations by Inter are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
19' 0 - 1 What a hit! Davide Frattesi (Inter) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 0:1.
17' Yann Bisseck (Inter) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
15' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
13' A crossfield pass from Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) fails to find any of his teammates.
12' Reinier (Frosinone) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
11' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
8' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
8' Some neat passing and movement from Inter as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
4' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.
4' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Yann Sommer easily deals with the threat.
2' Corner kick. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Frosinone will kick-off.
Antonio Giua was nominated as the referee for this game.
